title: Terraform module for centralized VPC logging: CloudTrail + OpenSearch ILM + retention controls
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a reusable Terraform module to provision centralized logging and audit infrastructure for Private (VPC) deployments. The module should wire CloudTrail (management and data events) into an OpenSearch/ELK stack hosted inside the customer VPC or connected via secure peering, provide lifecycle/retention policies for indices, S3 archival for CloudTrail logs, IAM roles with least privilege, and configurable settings for retention windows, index rollover (ILM), encryption (KMS), and access controls. Goal is to standardize audit logging across Private deployments and make upgrades/retention policy changes manageable via IaC.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module publishes CloudTrail trail with configurable event selectors (management, data) and S3 bucket for raw logs
Module provisions an OpenSearch domain (or config for external cluster) with index templates and ILM policies matching retention TTLs
Configurable retention: short-term indices (hot/warm), rollover after size/time, and archival to S3 for >90 days
KMS-managed encryption for S3 and OpenSearch snapshots with customer-provided key ID option
Module exposes inputs for VPC/subnet placement, security group rules, and supports VPC endpoints for S3/OpenSearch
Preflight IAM policy document and least-privilege roles created; module outputs IAM ARNs and Terraform plan shows no excessive wildcards
Module includes health-check Terraform null_resource scripts/hooks that run quick checks (CloudTrail status, OpenSearch cluster health, snapshot lifecycle existence) and fail CI if unhealthy
Documentation and example usage for private deployment (VPC peering and account-level vs per-deployment) included in the repo
Integration E2E test runs in CI that provisions resources in a sandbox account and validates retention lifecycle and snapshot restore path
implementation_plan: Draft module interface: inputs/outputs and defaults (retention_days, enable_data_events, kms_key_arn, opensearch_instance_type, external_opensearch_endpoint)
Create CloudTrail resource with S3 destination and optional CloudWatch Logs delivery; include event selectors for S3, Lambda, DynamoDB as toggles
Add S3 bucket lifecycle rules and encryption via aws_s3_bucket and aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration
Provision OpenSearch resources with aws_opensearch_domain (or module variable to accept external endpoint), index templates, ILM policies using _ilm API via templates
Implement automated snapshot schedule to S3 and lifecycle transition policies for snapshots older than N days
Build IAM roles/policies with least privilege (CloudTrail -> S3, ES snapshot role, delivery role) and test policies against policy simulator
Add VPC-configurable network controls: security group rules, subnet associations, VPC endpoints for S3/OpenSearch
Add health-check hooks (Terraform null_resource) running small Python/Go scripts to call AWS APIs and OpenSearch _cluster/health
Write docs, examples, and run CI job to provision in a sandbox account; capture screenshots and perf metrics
Ship initial beta module and request security review; iterate on feedback
upgrade_notes: When upgrading OpenSearch major version, create blue/green domain and reindex via snapshot/restore; document steps and ensure data retention windows are honored
ILM policy changes that shorten retention must trigger snapshot to S3 before deletion; add a safety window and admin confirmation flag
Avoid in-place domain engine upgrades for critical deployments; module should expose toggle to create new domain resource for painless migration
Plan for CloudTrail selector changes: adding data events can create high volume—include cost warning in plan output
health_checks: CloudTrail.IsLogging: AWS API check that trail is active and logging=true
S3.BucketAccessible: head-bucket and PutObject test to ensure write permissions for delivery
OpenSearch.ClusterHealth: check _cluster/health returns status green or yellow and node count >= expected
ILM.PolicyExists: verify ILM policy is installed and index template matches pattern
SnapshotLifecycle: ensure snapshot schedule exists and lastSnapshot timestamp < snapshot_schedule_interval*2
KMS.KeyAccessible: simulate encryption/decryption with provided KMS key grant
testing_plan: Unit tests for Terraform modules using terratest (Go) to validate plan & common parameterizations
Integration test in CI: provision in sandbox AWS account, generate synthetic events (S3 PUT, Lambda invocation) and assert CloudTrail logs reach S3 and are indexed into OpenSearch
ILM/retention test: create indices, simulate rollover conditions, validate snapshot archival and eventual deletion after retention period
Policy/privilege test: run policy simulator to ensure no iam:* wildcards in produced policies
Failure recovery test: simulate OpenSearch node failure and verify health-check scripts catch degraded state and CI fails
